checks.name: Strict requirements and owner intent; prepare idempotency and cold restoration
Host rejects real review with mismatched exact requirements or parent lineage
Saved candidate reconnect failure only retries basket commit; explicit replace preserves identity position points; receipt immutable
Explicit add retains original and appends once; cancellation rejects acceptance
Entry edit or revision change and parent version change reject exact intent; abort rolls back
C2 exact verification required and original primitive synchronizes entryPoints; no metadata loss
Run admission binding is durable, required and exact; same-prompt other run cannot attach
Cancelled or aborted admission never attaches candidates; route and sub-intent admission enforced
More than ten thousand legacy/UI receipts do not consume adaptation quota or get rewritten
A27 prepare rejects absent generation quota and source-only policy before writing intent; practice full-section add is rejected while replace fits
Replacing an existing generated entry reuses its quota slot; adding another cannot consume an occupied slot
Accept independently checks persisted legacy prepared intents for quota and section capacity, preserving saved candidate facts and rolling back
A later failed run preserves confirmed saved effect and permits exact explicit attachment; cancelled intent and changed parent remain blocked
Failed-run pending candidates never gain display or attachment privileges
Prompt over 32768 rejects too_large before intent receipt without truncating current instance
Five existing IPC channels validate sender and malformed input
